name: Charging, no popup
shown_when: Baseline before sync or with no active notice.

name: Checking flights…
shown_when: Find eligible flights on the SD card.

name: Starting WiFi…
shown_when: Selected flight needs a saved WiFi connection.

name: Connecting…
shown_when: WiFi ready; waiting for a valid network clock.

name: Uploading 1 of 2
shown_when: First flight upload and response handling.

name: Preparing 2 of 2
shown_when: Select/recheck the next flight after the first result.

name: Uploading 2 of 2
shown_when: Second flight upload and response handling.

name: Uploaded 2 of 2 / Preparing USB…
shown_when: Batch processed; SD handoff is next.

name: Uploads complete / USB drive ready
shown_when: Five-second completion notice.

name: Charging after completion
shown_when: Completion notice closed; no popup.

name: Upload paused / Retry scheduled
shown_when: Transient failure; visible for 30 seconds.

name: Retry pending, popup hidden
shown_when: Retry still scheduled after notice disappears.

name: Hold center to turn on
shown_when: Waiting to distinguish tap from hold. Text clips.

name: USB unavailable
shown_when: USB handoff failed; press retries USB.

name: Uploads complete / USB unavailable
shown_when: Batch processed but USB handoff failed.

name: Turning On / Please wait…
shown_when: Power-on request without a confirmed mounted USB host.

name: Turning On / Closing USB…
shown_when: Power-on request with mounted host; SD return pending.

name: No SD card, no popup
shown_when: Missing-card indicator is part of the charging page.

name: Preparing 100/100
shown_when: Compact counter fallback for a large queue.

name: Uploading 100/100
shown_when: Compact counter fallback for a large queue.

name: Uploaded 1000/1000
shown_when: Compact counter fallback while preparing USB.

name: Preparing
shown_when: Verb-only fallback when even a compact counter is too wide.

name: Uploading
shown_when: Verb-only fallback when even a compact counter is too wide.

name: Uploaded
shown_when: Verb-only fallback while preparing USB.
